summary: San Luis Obispo County lookout staffed in 1953 and threatened by a 1939 fire; Forest Service kept it to 1973 and its cab was moved to Rocky Butte.

access.note: Forest Service campground at the base of the peak; Wikipedia describes a few summit routes. No source describes the summit site today. Public level inferred from the open campground and summit routes.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Service gives 2,620 feet; Wikipedia gives 2,624 feet. The four-foot gap is minor and the story uses the Forest Service figure.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build year; the Rocky Butte record says only that the cab replaced a CCC-era lookout on Cerro Alto, so the story says CCC-era with no year. The date the cab left Cerro Alto is not given; the story says only that it moved after the Forest Service closed the station. The Rocky Butte record spells the crew as CDC; the story writes crews. The 1939 item is from The San Bernardino County Sun and the 1953 item from The Arroyo Grande Valley Herald Recorder, both as transcribed by Forest Lookouts. The SLO Tribune lookouts article timed out twice and was not used. The brief access value of unknown is replaced with public; that level is inferred from the campground and summit routes. Confidence is medium because the history comes from transcribed newspapers and secondary records.
